instructions: SECTION 1 · You will hear a man phoning a leisure centre. First, you have some time to look at questions 1–10.

groups.instructions: Complete the form below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.strategy: Section 1 tests spelling and numbers. Before the audio starts, predict each gap: a name? a number? a day? Listen for corrections ('no, sorry…') — the first thing you hear is often a distractor.

questions.explanation: Spelled out letter by letter: K-O-W-A-L-S-K-I. Spelling must be exact.
The number is said and then repeated by the receptionist — use the repetition to check.
Off-Peak is rejected (he works in the day) and Premium is rejected (no sauna or classes).
questions.trap: All three types are mentioned; wait for his final decision.

questions.explanation: 'normally twenty-five pounds, but this month we've reduced it to fifteen'.
questions.trap: 25 is the normal fee — a classic distractor.

questions.prompt: Heard about the centre from: a ________
questions.explanation: He first says 'a poster at the library' then corrects himself: 'It was a friend from work'.

questions.prompt: Pool lanes reserved for the club on ________ evenings
questions.explanation: 'lanes are reserved for the swimming club on Tuesday evenings'. Days need a capital letter in the real test.

questions.prompt: Free parking: must register car's ________ number
questions.explanation: 'register your car's registration number at reception'.
'all new members have to attend an induction session'.
'please bring a photo for your membership card'.
